verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS research tool, since vendors can ship on-prem or self-hosted deployments. The evidence pack shows no self-hosted, on-prem or open-source deployment option for Elicit. The API and MCP server it documents are hosted endpoints at elicit.com, not self-hosting, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
